title: nodes/<path>/<id>/index.json, kind while
description: A while loop: a folder described by its index.json (plain JSON, no front matter).

label.description: The display name of the flow node (the rail, History and the diagram show it); never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the flow node).

format.description: The node's return type, written, and checked against the type its ret gives it: a format name or an inline schema.

reproducible.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true only if everything in its body that its result depends on is true.

producer.description: A flow node is computed even when its body holds agent nodes.

modelDerived.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when its ret, or anything its result is made from, is model-derived.

runDependent.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when its source or its ret is run-dependent.

profileCarrying.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when its source or its ret is profile-carrying.

while.description: The check: the body runs again while it holds.

max.description: The bound on passes, 1 to 15; there is no default.

until.description: Checked after each pass, or null for none; whichever of while and until stops first wins.

checkFirst.description: false checks after each pass (at least one pass); true checks before each pass (zero passes possible).

nodes.description: The body, in order: at least one id, each once.

ret.description: The body node whose last pass's value the while returns.
